name: Jest of Stolen Sight
body:
School: evocation [force]; Level: jester 5

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 immediate action

EFFECT

Range: Medium (130 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Target: one creature

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: Reflex half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target takes 2d6 points of force damage +1 point per caster level. The target who fails its save is also blinded until the end of your next turn.
